title: Annon Aadhaar
tagline: A simple example of Anon Aadhar for using vote, review and many more.
description: This is a simple example of Anon Aadhaar, which can be used for voting, reviewing, and many more applications. It will not reveal any user identity details, such as their Aadhaar number, name, etc. Instead, it generates proof so that the real identity will not be viewed by anyone. After this, we will move to the next version that can be used in different ways across various apps.
how_its_made: This project was created using Next.js for the frontend, and we have used the @anon-aadhaar SDK for generating the proof. It will create proof of your Aadhaar ID without revealing any personal data, and can be used in dApps for voting and more. Currently, users can try using a dummy test QR code to generate the proof.
